question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4. **
solution:
The correct answer is: first

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• "Last" means at the end; after all the others.
 
• "First" means coming before all others; that has not happened or experienced before.
 
• "Future" means the period of time that is about to come.
 
• "Next" means something immediately following the present one.
 
 
 
• *​*As per the meaning of the given words "first"* *is the appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 2.
